newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Q3 consumption points to strong GDP - finmin.
newsitem.headline: French Q3 consumption points to strong GDP - finmin.

text.p: A rise of 2.6 percent in French consumer spending on manufactured goods in the third quarter supports expectations of a strong rise in gross domestic product in the period, a finance ministry official said on Thursday.
National statistics institute INSEE said earlier consumption fell 1.5 percent in September from the previous month.
However, the official highlighted the rise over the whole of the third quarter, which he said "supports expectations of a strong rise in GDP for the same period."
National statistics institute INSEE has forecast a rise of one percent in third quarter GDP.
The official also noted that September this year had included only four Saturdays compared to five in 1995.

Moreover, the return to school had been earlier than usual so families made their purchases in the last days of August, while big stores planned their sales promotions for October rather than September, he said.
